title: MGDA source-KL seventh-objective seed0 continuation smoke
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: Adding Standard10 KL as a seventh unit-normalized common-descent objective during a matched 8k-to-12k continuation will correct seed0 source-boundary drift without sacrificing the six opponent-seat reward objectives or broad learned-anchor performance.
material_change: Clone the frozen seed0 MGDA 8k checkpoint and Adam into both arms. Collect one identical fresh 4,096-hand continuation cohort from the shared starting policy. Control applies six-objective MGDA; treatment adds base-to-candidate legal-action KL as a seventh MGDA objective, norm-matched to the same ordinary reward-gradient scale. Freeze at 12k, evaluate 1,024 new mirrored pairs per three anchors, and replay the prior 6,144-state preservation panel.
baseline: Seed0 8k MGDA had favorable pooled learning but relative Standard10 -2.173 combined and preservation audit KL 1.438x ordinary control; its greedy agreement remained 98.32%. This smoke targets that specific relative drift from the exact failing seed.
notes: Admission to seed1 replication requires exact shared start/optimizer and identical collection evidence; treatment positive alignment for all six reward objectives and KL on >=75% of steps; treatment 12k panel mean KL <= control and greedy agreement no worse than control by >0.5 point; treatment-control pooled >0, Standard10 >=0, >=2/3 anchors positive, both seats >=0; base/cap/hashes valid. A failure rejects this seventh-objective formulation, not the already-demonstrated six-objective learning mechanism.

First exact command completed both 4,096-hand collection executions and passed identity comparison, then failed at control optimizer step0 because source-KL and auxiliary gradients reused one autograd graph. No optimizer step, checkpoint, or evaluation occurred. Preserved raw evidence under run_autograd_preupdate_failure_20260901T1415; fixed auxiliary loss to use an independent forward and will rerun exact start/seed.

Second exact command completed both 32-step updates and wrote both 12k checkpoints, then failed before panel/evaluation because NumPy schedule arrays were not JSON serializable. Preserved raw evidence and pre-eval checkpoints under run_schedule_serialization_posttrain_failure_20260901T1420. Converted schedule arrays to lists only; deterministic rerun will restart from the immutable 8k checkpoint and Adam rather than continue partial output.

Independent raw recomputation confirmed 8,192 actual continuation hands (4,096 per arm), identical 8,959 transitions per arm, training SHA 3e3f6c97fca2872ba3d182d5eb134ef86085736cdb2b5014118678ab20a34e10, 3,072 evaluation pairs / 12,288 hands, and evaluation SHA 2dc1ea3f5f2de723974f3d66b31993b435fabb72abe89f2a0f74ae746105bedc.

Two recoverable implementation interruptions were preserved: one before optimizer step0 due graph reuse, and one after all training but before evaluation due schedule serialization. The accepted run restarted deterministically from the immutable 8k checkpoint and Adam; it did not resume partial optimizer state.

result.summary: The seventh-objective treatment achieved positive alignment for all six reward groups and source KL on 32/32 steps. It strongly improved outcome-blind preservation (panel agreement 99.35% versus control 96.45%; mean KL 0.000240 versus 0.003727), but matched poker performance was pooled -4.553 bb/100 CI[-27.184,18.078], Standard10 -13.306, Slumbot-free +0.916, CFR96 -1.269, with both seat deltas negative.
result.conclusion: Unit-normalizing source KL as a seventh MGDA objective over-constrains useful policy movement: it optimizes the preservation proxy exactly while worsening actual reward breadth, including against Standard10 itself. This is clear mechanism-level evidence to reject this formulation despite small evaluation uncertainty. The unconstrained six-objective control remains a valid 12k continuation artifact and should be evaluated against its 8k parent separately.
result.next_step: Freeze the six-objective 12k control checkpoint and compare it directly with the immutable 8k MGDA parent on new common decks and the existing preservation panel. Use that untouched 8k-to-12k slope to decide whether unconstrained MGDA is undertrained or beginning to erode generality.
